*sunrising* is one English word carrying both morphemes' senses — the rising of mizraḥ and the sun of šemeš — so the pair shares one unit under rule 30, headed on the construct noun that carries the head lexeme. The supplied *toward* states what this adverbial accusative contributes and joins that nominal's unit under rule 33; the unit is discontinuous around the article under rule 25. The competing reading, taken in the earlier accepted alignment, gave *toward* to mizraḥ as rule 19's directional construct and *sunrising* to šemeš alone; it was set aside because rule 19's directional case requires the ASV to spend its word on the construct's lexeme instead of writing a noun for it, and here *sunrising* writes that lexeme, so neither half of the split is independently defensible under rule 2.
